thread:
alex: Evening async — quick buffer snapshot and a couple PR pings. What I did: pulled a region headroom report + rebalance suggestion. Blockers: waiting on AZ quota bump in eu-west-1. Today: filing the quota request and landing a small autoscaler tweak.

maria: Saw the snapshot, thanks. FYI eu-west-1 still shows low spot capacity for p4s, odds of eviction look ~8% over next 12h. I'm going to re-route non-critical canaries to us-west-2 tonight. :shipit:

chen: Re autoscaler tweak — left a comment on PR #342 in fleet-autoscaler about the smoothing window (15s -> 30s). Short window was spiking scale ops during the morning tilt. Ping me for a quick pairing if we want to roll it today.

sam: Re: quota bump — who owns the support ticket? I can escalate with cloud partner if you drop the request ID.

alex: @sam sending request ID now: SR-78941234. I drafted the support text, will paste below. Can someone +1 before I escalate?

alex: "Hello support, requesting a temporary +6 p4d capacity in eu-west-1 (region-wide) for 6 hours starting 2024-08-02T22:00Z to support model warmup and canaries. Impact: high priority for canary rollouts; automated fallback to us-west-2 in place. Contact: alex@redwood.com."

jordan: +1. Also added a small patch to node-drain-scripts so drains don't evict cached KV for warmup lanes — repro in staging looked good. PR #129.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window in ap-southeast-1 tomorrow 01:00-02:00 UTC. Auto-fallback enabled for dedicated customers.

maria: Blocker for me: permission to approve the eu-wide routing change. Need platform-ops approval. I filed a doc in /confluence/ops/routing-change with details.

chen: Quick capacity check command I used: ```bash
curl -s http://capacity-api.internal/v1/regions | jq '.eu-west-1 | {headroom, spot_risk}'
# returned: {"headroom": 12, "spot_risk": 0.08}
```

alex: Nice. Based on that I propose: (1) escalate SR, (2) merge autoscaler smoothing patch to reduce churn, (3) route low-priority traffic to us-west-2 overnight. If we get the quota bump we revert routing.

sam: I'm on the escalate path. Will message partner Slack after you post the support text. Also looping legal for the temporary cross-region routing note (just in case).

jordan: Quick ask — can someone review PR #342 (chen's smoothing) + #129 (my drain patch)? Both are small. If either lands, we should see lower prewarm cost and fewer eviction-induced tail latency blips.

maria: Reviewing #129 now. Will leave comments or approve in ~20m.

chen: Thanks — I'll tag staging rollout once #342 is green. Plan: staggered canaries, 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m if metrics are stable.

alex: Final note: I'm adding a one-time metric to the dashboard: per-AZ prewarm utilization and eviction-counts so oncall can triage faster. Should be live in ~45m. Good night y'all, ping if anything blocks the SR. :coffee:
